rights: 1911 published work; public domain in the United States; extracted lexical facts and editorial transcription
extraction: Existing Internet Archive OCR/PDF text layer; all installed forms, heading glosses and labels visually checked at 1500px page scale. No new OCR engine run.
coverage: All 185 numbered lexical headings, their numbered subsenses, and explicit unlocalized bee-nest, old-man/woman and pig alternate attestations.
exclusions: Comparative Sinhala/Tamil/Sanskrit/Pali/etc. etymological words are not Vedda attestations.
Unnumbered etymological discussion is preserved in pages.json and audit OCR, excluded from graph assertions and display Etymology.
Songs, narrative word mentions, preceding chapters, and following Kaele-base appendix are outside the vocabulary scope.
language_policy: Separate Vedda base language, Glottocode vedd1240; Other avoids resolving the historical Sinhala-dialect versus isolate/contact-language classification. No historical locality coordinates inferred from a modern language point.
dialect_policy: 11 unambiguous place labels registered. O names consultant Wannaku of Uniche, retained as provenance. T is ambiguous beside explicit Tk and is retained verbatim with typed review flag; no invented Tamil or Tamankaduwa mapping.
profile_policy: Explicit preservation of the historical broad transcription; c already has house affricate value. Do not infer length, retroflexion, or nasal quality from Sinhala comparanda. Phonemic/Native blank because no separate IPA/native-script field is supplied.

sample.checked: All emitted forms/glosses/labels compared to the previously rendered original pages.
